policy_title: Hepatic Fibrosis Testing Chronic Liver Disease Policy

sections.title: Application
sections.content: This reimbursement policy applies to all Medicare Advantage products and for network provider services reported using the UB04 and CMS 1500 form or its electronic equivalent or its successor form.

children.title: Overview
children.content: This policy describes the reimbursement methodology for serum testing for hepatic fibrosis subject to frequency limitations. Certain services are also not separately reimbursable.

children.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
content: UnitedHealthcare will consider reimbursement of the following multianalyte assay testing procedure code(s) once every six months to distinguish hepatic cirrhosis from non-cirrhosis for individuals with any of the conditions listed below:

Condition(s) a. Hepatitis B b. Hepatitis C c. Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) (including metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis [MASH]). d. Alcoholic hepatitis.

value.Q: Is the frequency limitation based on individual provider per member?
value.A: The frequency limitation is applicable regardless of billing and/or rendering provider (any individual provider OR any facility) for each individual member for the same date of service.
